title: Community Solar Subscriptions Enrollment Matrix: States, Premise Class, Income Qualification and Channels
content:
Enrollment terms that differ, or could differ, by plan of Community Solar Subscriptions are set out in the matrix below. Beacon Ridge sells Community Solar Subscriptions in Illinois (IL), Maryland (MD) and New Jersey (NJ).

| Plan | Eligible states | Premise class served | Income qualification required | Utility customer assistance program enrollment satisfies income qualification | Enrollment channels | Waitlist order | Project assignment | Live subscriptions per premise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | IL, MD, NJ | residential | No | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | IL, MD, NJ | residential | No | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | IL, MD, NJ | residential | No | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | IL, MD, NJ | residential | No | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | IL, MD, NJ | residential | No | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | IL, MD, NJ | residential | Yes | Yes | phone, web | first come, first served by subscribe date | nearest open project in the utility | 1 |

## Matrix notes

- **States.** Every plan is offered in IL, MD and NJ, the states with a community solar program in which the plans are offered.
- **Premise class.** Every plan serves residential premises.
- **Income qualification.** Only Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible requires the subscriber to be income-qualified. On every plan, enrollment in the utility's customer assistance program satisfies income qualification.
- **Channels.** A subscription may be started by phone or on the web.
- **Waitlist order.** Waitlisted subscribers receive capacity first come, first served, by subscribe date.
- **Project assignment.** The project is the nearest open project in the subscriber's utility.
- **Per premise.** One live subscription is allowed per premise.

## Hypothetical comparison

Two hypothetical households in the same utility subscribe on 4 May and 9 May. Under the first-come, first-served basis by subscribe date, the 4 May subscriber stands ahead of the 9 May subscriber on the waitlist.
